				text 'Customer Reviews'
				text "Best screen protectors I've used!"
				LayoutTable
					LayoutTableRow '| Rating 100 |'
				text 'It is super clear and fingerprint resistant. It was kind of hard trying to get it on, and I did get some hairs on the sticky side, but all in all it was great! Bubbles went away around the small hairs so you can barely tell they are there. They also give you tons of extra tools to help you clean the screen and get dust particles off of the screen before you put it on. I think it was just me being clumsy with all of the dust particles getting inside the screen.'
				text 'Rachel'
				time '4/18/23'
				text 'Good screen protector for the money and good customer service'
				LayoutTable
					LayoutTableRow '| Rating 80 |'
				text 'This is the second time I have used this product. It is a little tricky to apply. I had it on my phone for about 10 months and had dropped my phone a few times without incident. The last drop shattered the protector but thankfully did what it was supposed to do and protected my phone screen. The second one in the package had a small chip in it, which caused it to have a hairline crack all the way through. I emailed the company and they were very quick to respond and sent a new one free of charge. I am very satisfied with the product and only give it a four star rating because it is sometimes very difficult to get out the bubbles. I have 2 very tiny specks that would just not come out.'
				text 'chris'
				time '4/18/23'
				text 'Bubbles still there after a few days'
				LayoutTable
					LayoutTableRow '| Rating 80 |'
				text "OK, so my first impression was, wow it worked with only 1 small bubble. I was like OK, it's normal to have a few small bubbles. The description says that the small bubbles will disappear after a couple days. Well it's been over a week and the one small tiny bubble is still there. It never went away. Ugh I need to add this to my review. The glue does not last forever. It started to come off about a month after I put it on. The bad thing when it does start to come off, it's easy to take off the screen protectant."
				text 'StrykerTK'
				time '4/18/23'
				text 'I am disappointed that there appears to be no adhesive on the ...'
				LayoutTable
					LayoutTableRow '| Rating 40 |'
				text 'I am disappointed that there appears to be no adhesive on the right edge of the mine that goes the full length of the phone. The packaging it comes in is nice and helps with storage of the extras.Edit/update:The seller did send a replacement product. However the same results were achieved with the replacement product. This occurred even with careful application and careful cleaning. I did change 1 star to 2 based on the sellers attempt to provide a quality product but it appears the right 1/8 of the screen in missing adhesive.'
				text 'DaniLee14'
				time '4/18/23'
				text 'Great screen protector'
				LayoutTable
					LayoutTableRow '| Rating 100 |'
				text "Nice product. Seems much better than the one replaced, it does seem to resist fingerprints and stay cleaner. This is noticeable especially for swipe entries as my finger glides much more easily in the screen. All else is good so far. I didn't do a great job putting it on, a few bubbles and dust specks. But it works so well I don't want to remove it.Not enough to remove a star, but the packaging is a bit overkill. I think it can be recycled but the cost could come down even more without the tin case."
				text 'T. Gannon'
				time '4/18/23'
				text 'Just as advertised'
				LayoutTable
					LayoutTableRow '| Rating 80 |'
				text "I received the order as promised, all neatly packaged and all items clearly labeled. Easy to follow instructions, however the first alcohol packet I opened to clean my screen was completely dry, so couldn't use it. I used one screen so far, still have a tiny air pocket in center of screen, tried removing it, (probably user error here) but couldn't be bothered switching out the perfectly good screen at this time. I'd recommend this product, great value!"
				text 'Jacqueline F'
				time '4/18/23'
				text 'good screen protector for my Samsung Android'
				LayoutTable
					LayoutTableRow '| Rating 100 |'
				text "Just as good as any high quality protector. easy application, instructions and it's also tough and looks good. I've dropped my phone a few times, it did have a case protector also , though it received no damage and the screen protector looks good and works perfectly with ease, screen is very responsive to light touch. would buy again."
				text 'DAN'
				time '4/18/23'
				text 'Great improvement over plastic protectors!'
				LayoutTable
					LayoutTableRow '| Rating 80 |'
				text 'The protector is high quality and relatively easy to install, with caveats. It needs to be about 1mm wider to fully cover the screen though - there\'s no "wiggle room" in placing the protector on the screen. If you have weak vision or shaky hands, you\'ll find this very frustrating.Speaking of installation, be sure to apply the hinges lengthwise on the phone as shown in online videos, not widthwise as shown in the instructions - the temporary hinge will be more stable. Also, the hinge adhesive isn\'t very strong - be sure to secure it well before proceeding with the installation procedure.Once installed, you\'ll really notice the improvement of glass over plastic protectors. Elimination of air bubbles is easy, the screen is brighter/clearer, and your finger just glides over the screen - nice!'
				text 'Open Source Prof'
				time '4/18/23'
				text "Take a lot of care and it'll likely be great."
				LayoutTable
					LayoutTableRow '| Rating 80 |'
				text "Really a 3.5. It was a pain to put on without any subscreen issues. I got the bubbles mostly out, but the tiniest speck of dust caused a noticeable blemish that annoyed me eventually to the point of removing it to put back on. I had to pick at the sticky side to get the dust off which left marks from my finger. I washed the sticky side in hopes that it was like some other stick/adhesives that are meant to be washed. It didn't seem to mees up the adhesive capability of the scree, but it doesn't look as night and didn't install super cleanly.I have the second screen, which is good to have, for when this one bugs me enough to replace. I guess one needs to be VERY careful about their environment when they install it. The very edges never REALLY adhered, but they aren't curling up or anything bad and they are just beyond he actual LCD area, so don't mess with how it looks.I've not put it through any stress tests and typically only have rare loose change in the same pocket, but it's not got a scratch on it after 3 months."
				text 'Chris Moran'
				time '4/18/23'
				text 'Good product, good price.'
				LayoutTable
					LayoutTableRow '| Rating 80 |'
				text 'This is my third purchase of this item. It has proven rugged, but the slide off the roof to the gravel driveway below was too much for it, and used up my last protector from my previous order.Had others in the past and they didn\'t seem to hold up as well. Additionally, I ALWAYS have an issue with them lifting up at the edges, probably because of the stresses induced when you "roll" them down from center to edge or from one edge to the other. This one seems to lift less than others I\'ve used.If the phone survives another year of my abuse, I\'ll probably be reordering another set of these without having to spend hours researching which one is best.'

				text 'Great improvement over plastic protectors!'
				LayoutTable
					LayoutTableRow '| Rating 80 |'
				text 'The protector is high quality and relatively easy to install, with caveats. It needs to be about 1mm wider to fully cover the screen though - there\'s no "wiggle room" in placing the protector on the screen. If you have weak vision or shaky hands, you\'ll find this very frustrating.Speaking of installation, be sure to apply the hinges lengthwise on the phone as shown in online videos, not widthwise as shown in the instructions - the temporary hinge will be more stable. Also, the hinge adhesive isn\'t very strong - be sure to secure it well before proceeding with the installation procedure.Once installed, you\'ll really notice the improvement of glass over plastic protectors. Elimination of air bubbles is easy, the screen is brighter/clearer, and your finger just glides over the screen - nice!'
